roles.meaning: One actual Gold Standard page establishes navy/gold/cream series presentation, painterly finish and page-level dignity.
One actual Gold Standard page or reviewed crop demonstrates the intended panel rhythm, camera hierarchy or immersive structure.
An exact, human-approved character asset conditions identity only.
roles.fail_closed: If no human-approved exact asset exists, record UNAVAILABLE_NO_HUMAN_APPROVED_ASSET and use the locked text registry; never promote a PR6 FIX image into a character reference.

roles.meaning: An approved location reference controls recurring geography, light and spatial anchors.
roles.fail_closed: If no approved exact setting image exists, bind the location-bible record and report image conditioning as unavailable.

new_story_specification: Contains only the current DM04 page/panel, locked source events, character IDs, location ID, one principal action and approved visual proposals.
execution_evidence: provider operation declares reference conditioning or edit support
request contains each exact reference path, hash and role
provider receipt attests the references actually submitted
independent review checks both alignment and forbidden content transfer
unsupported_behavior: Capability metadata alone does not prove conditioning executed. If the provider receipt cannot evidence direct inputs, mark REFERENCE_CONDITIONING_EXECUTION_UNKNOWN.
